hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, wrapping/unwrapping ETH through the phiEth contract, and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity pricing. Pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee, and direct liquidity addition is blocked.
